reason: No auto-charge means I'd actually start the 14-day trial without worrying, but on day 14 I'd just drop to the free version or go back to YouTube. Even with a few minutes saved, paying monthly for sleep sounds is hard to justify when free ones already work okay for me.
objection: YouTube sleep music is free and does mostly the same job, so 4,900 won a month for 'smarter' sounds feels like one more subscription I'll forget I'm paying for.
would_change_my_mind: If my day-14 record showed a big, obvious drop, like falling asleep 15+ minutes faster, I might pay for one month to see if it holds.
